root_cause.mechanism: When a barcode half has no peaks above threshold, max_fallback uses np.argmax(signal). For all-zero (or flat-zero) signals, argmax returns index 0 → first barcode in that half (sbc1 or sbc97) → grid coordinate 1.
root_cause.pipeline_step: spatial_assigning.ipynb cell that runs demux_all_cells on non-confident cells and merges results back, overwriting None assignments from the top-2 ratio method.
